name: narration-pronunciation
about: Audits a speechkit narration word by word: every spoken word is tracked, the narration is heard back by an offline recognizer, and the voice's phonemes are checked against the CMU reference dictionary. A fix is promoted only if it lowers confirmed mispronunciations without making recognition worse.

notes.count_thresholds: Counts use a threshold of 0.5 so they pass only at zero while the score still rises with every word fixed (credit = 0.5 / count).
